payload.title: Wire the CLI to the store: store-backed verbs and specs
payload.description:
**Intent:** Phase 1 store verbs of the CLI design (comment 773667 on BOTSPY-7c2705). The local store has landed (BOTSPY-c7795b, feat/local-store PR #4: SQLite + WAL, FTS5, sqlite-vec, incremental refresh) — wire the botspy CLI to it.

**Scope:** `import` (incremental CDC into the local store, `--dry-run` reporting, per-source skip summary, `--full`), `stats` (aggregates over the store: sessions/messages/turns/parts, usage where recorded, `--by day|source|project` pivots), `search --mode text` (FTS5 through the store), and engine-side `sessions` filters (source/project/kind/time, `--limit`). Specs first under `features/cli/`: Gherkin scenarios per verb (executable red before implementation), then the thinnest implementation — every verb is exactly one library call plus rendering; the store engine stays invisible to the flags; read-only MVP verbs (sources/sessions/show/doctor/snapshot) keep working unchanged.

**Acceptance:** features/cli scenarios for the store-backed verbs reviewed and red first, then green via `cargo test --test bdd`; existing suites stay green; all gates pass (cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test; cargo test --test bdd). Work on a branch off origin/develop; PR to develop only (GitFlow, never main). 2>/dev/null; echo
